skill1: Activates when hits 2 or more enemies concurrently. Affects all enemies hit. Deals 50.33% of final ATK as additional damage.

caveats: ⚑ skill2 cadence: the 112.64% line carries NO activation clause and the packet supplies no datamined skill cooldown — modeled as interval 10s, first fire at t=10s (no 'Forcefully uses Skill' clause ⇒ interval convention). Every skill-bucket number scales linearly with this guess.

⚑ skill1 pierce duration: 'for 1 round(s)' is a ROUND count, but gainPierce has no durationShots field — converted to durationSec 2.0 (≈ one SR charge-fire cycle) so pierce stays live across consecutive shots without spanning the reload gap. Not a measured value.

⚑ skill1 trigger: 'attacking with Full Charge' is modeled as shotFired — there is no full-charge trigger kind, and an SR at scope lock full-charges every shot. If any kit/mode path fires her uncharged, this over-fires.

⚑ cadence tuple: chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 / ammo 6 are datamined fields on the known-unreliable list; her shot economy (and therefore the burst's Max Ammunition ▲6 gain) rests on them unmeasured.
Pierce is offensively INERT at scope lock unless a teammate carries Pierce Damage ▲ (pierceDamagePct is parsed-but-inert in v1); the gainPierce effect is kept for tagging fidelity, not for damage.

The skill1 multi-enemy branch (2+ enemies hit concurrently) is structurally unreachable on the single, partless scope-lock boss — its 50.33% rider contributes zero and is recorded in unmodeled rather than modeled behind an unreachable gate.

Riders (skill2 instant, burst instant) are authored crit-eligible at the caster's sheet rate and take NO core (no 'core strike' wording); the burn DoT is left non-crit per the default-OFF DOT_CRIT gate (crit opt-in is measured-only).
noFb / noRange are deliberately unset: full-burst eligibility is by landing TIMING (default on) and the range exemption is engine-automatic on riders.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Independent prose→JSON read of Nihilister (nihilister, SR/Fire/Attacker/Burst II). Modeled: S1 full-charge Pierce tag (shotFired → gainPierce, ⚑2.0s stand-in for '1 round'); S2 range-wide 112.64% instant on an ⚑interval-10s cadence (no activation clause in the kit text ⇒ interval per the trigger taxonomy); burst 158.59% instant + a 13.19%/s × 10s sustained Burn (one DoT instance per cast, append-not-refresh) + a self Max Ammunition ▲6 rounds for 15s (a weapon-state modifier — it doubles her 6-round magazine and removes reloads inside the window, so it IS damage). Deliberately unmodeled: Piercing Radius ▲50% (no StatKey; a multi-target geometry stat with no meaning against one partless boss) and the whole 'hits 2 or more enemies concurrently' branch incl. its 50.33% rider (the gate cannot be satisfied at scope lock). Burst instant damage resolves pre-Full-Burst by engine convention; the Burn ticks then run through the FB window and take the +50% by tick timing.

flags.estimate: interval 10s, first fire at t=10s (~17 procs over a 180s fight)
flags.reasoning: The 112.64% line carries NO activation clause, so the taxonomy routes it to `interval`; the packet supplies no datamined skillCooldownsSec (the '20s' in the base stats is the Burst II cooldown, not a skill cooldown). 10s is the modal cooldown for an always-on AoE skill-damage line. First fire at t=sec (not t=0) because the kit has no 'Forcefully uses Skill N' clause — the interval-trigger convention. This single value scales her entire skill bucket linearly.
flags.recipe: Read nihilister's datamined skillCooldownsSec from data/ and set sec directly. Independently: focus-record a 180s fight and count the 112.64%-shaped popups — 18 vs 12 vs 36 cleanly discriminates 10s / 15s / 5s, and the FIRST popup's timestamp pins the phase (t=0 vs t=CD).

flags.reasoning: '1 round(s)' is a ROUND count, not wall-clock, but `gainPierce` exposes only durationSec (no durationShots). Her cycle is chargeFrames 60 (1.0s) + 22-frame release latency + recovery, so ~1.5–2.0s per shot; 2.0s keeps pierce continuously live while she is firing and lets it lapse across the 141-frame (~2.35s) reload rather than running permanently. Authoring it with durationSec ABSENT would make pierce permanent from her first shot, over-crediting any ally Pierce Damage ▲ during reloads.
flags.recipe: Measure her real shot interval from focus footage (ammo-counter decrements) and set durationSec to exactly one interval; or extend gainPierce with a durationShots field mirroring the buff round-count semantics and author durationShots:1.

flags.reasoning: No `fullCharge` trigger kind exists in the schema. An SR at scope lock charges to full on every shot, so shotFired and 'attacking with Full Charge' coincide; the approximation only breaks if some path lets her release uncharged (none in this kit text).
flags.recipe: Confirm from a focus recording that every one of her shots is a full charge (no tap-fire), i.e. shot count == full-charge count over a magazine.

flags.estimate: as datamined; ~1.0s charge, ~2.35s reload, 6→12 rounds under the burst buff
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: the datamined cadence fields are on the known-unreliable list, and here they do double duty — the 15s Max Ammunition ▲6 window's whole value is (shots fired with a 12-round magazine) − (shots fired with 6 + one reload), so a wrong reloadFrames misprices the burst's self-buff, not just her normal bucket.
flags.recipe: Ammo-counter read on a focus recording: time 6 consecutive shots for the fire cycle, and reload-start→refill frames for reloadFrames; re-check the same window during her 15s burst buff to confirm the magazine reads 12.

flags.estimate: 0 contribution at scope lock (unmodeled, not gated)
flags.reasoning: The activation needs 2+ concurrent enemies; the scope-lock boss is single and partless, so no authoring of this block could ever fire. Recording it in `unmodeled` keeps the no-silent-drops ledger honest without shipping a dead block — but it means this override is NOT portable to any multi-target content.
flags.recipe: If multi-target/adds content is ever simulated, model it as a flatDamage 50.33% on the same shotFired trigger with an enemy-count gate; validate by popup-counting a wave fight where 2+ targets sit inside her pierce line.
